name: Dark Root
related_quests: Consuming Darkness: Delve into Oblivion and save Bakkhara.
Pledge: Elden Hollow II: Explore Elden Hollow II and return Undaunted.
summary: The Dark Root is a shadowy spriggan found within Elden Hollow II. It is summoned from the first portal that Kargand enters from after Dubroze the Infestor's defeat, and is the first boss. Its unique drop is the Dark Root of Restoration.
